scope: public source and exact local OEM static comparison; no new hardware evidence

findings.fact: Public ChipInfoTypes defines SDA865 family 93 and SM8250 alias; exact enuma DisplayDxe compares family to 93 at RVA 0x3620.
findings.implication: SM8250-specific clock branch is relevant when real GetChipFamily returns that value; runtime value not observed.

findings.fact: Exact enuma PE locates Clock GUID 241afae6-885f-4f6c-a7ea-c28eab79c3e5 at 0x3640, then invokes GetClockID +8 at 0x3668 and EnableClock +16 at 0x3694 for gcc_disp_ahb_clk, disp_cc_mdss_rscc_ahb_clk, disp_cc_mdss_rscc_vsync_clk. Fixed EFIClock header matches fetched upstream bytes.
findings.implication: Concrete unwrapped method interval between last v6 entry page and later HAL IOMMU query; EnableClock result is not tested before next iteration; failure/hang is possible, not established.

findings.fact: Observed SID GUID 54b6d3b4-5d33-4f91-8600-6c41d5deb19a is publicly named gEfiHalIommuProtocolGuid (older gEfiSmmuProtocolGuid). Exact enuma query at 0x1bcdc returns to 0x1bce0; then +8 protocol call yields API table, table methods +0,+64,+16 execute, with client string \_SB_.MDP.
findings.implication: Public API table corresponds to domain-create, configure-bypass and attach-device. Mapping into exact enuma provider ABI still needs separate validation. Source Kona early MDP detach does not prove later OEM will not attach again.

findings.fact: Public old Qualcomm DisplayDxe registers events and initializes/detects display, installs GOP with Mode UINT32_MAX, and populates framebuffer in SetMode.
findings.implication: Core return, GOP publication, mode selection, usable framebuffer and console connection require separate evidence; old source is structural reference, not enuma exact code.

findings.fact: Mu-Silicium nabu is SM8150-AC and USE_CUSTOM_DISPLAY_DRIVER=1; pipa is SM8250-AC and USE_CUSTOM_DISPLAY_DRIVER=0. Early LonelyFool SM8250 uses PCD-derived SimpleFb with SetMode returning success without hardware initialization.
findings.implication: Related-device build or screen output cannot be cited as exact enuma OEM DisplayDxe success.

findings.fact: Mu-Silicium DisplayReEnabler and Aloha DisplayCaller call real DisplayPowerState off/stall/on; Aloha has optional EBS display-off behavior.
findings.implication: Conditional later display-power workaround after real protocol/mode confirmation; not an entry-stage fix and not a reason to copy board-specific values.

findings.fact: Upstream ChipInfo header GUID macro 61224fbe differs from DEC b0760469; OpenABL documents the distinction. Current enuma query uses b0760469 matching its native PE and DEC.
findings.implication: Not a newly found local GUID bug; do not replace current GUID from header macro alone.

findings.fact: Public HALIOMMU example installs protocol before a dummy-client initialization that may return EFI_NOT_READY.
findings.implication: Protocol lookup alone is insufficient provider health proof; exact enuma provider return and method pointer lifetime/ABI need checking. Old example does not establish enuma follows identical behavior.

findings.fact: Public EDK2 GraphicsConsoleControllerDriverStart queries supported modes and calls GOP SetMode when current mode differs; local fixed Mu code has the same relevant call sequence.
findings.implication: DXE module dispatch and console driver binding/controller connection are distinct. Current v9 intentionally terminates before BDS; it does not itself qualify controller connection/SetMode. A successful DXE/Core timing result must be followed by separately bounded GOP mode/console work.

next_actions: Keep frozen v9 images, qualifiers and trials unchanged; complete fresh paired calibration before target if user requests execution.
If earlier path requires further offline attribution, verify exact ClockDxe names/EnableClock internals and HALIOMMU publication/ABI against own-device binaries, preserving real statuses.
If target supports completed DXE plus real Core success, separately qualify protocol publication, GOP initial mode/SetMode and display power/control ownership before BDS.
Do not copy external SMMU stream IDs, modify memory/verified fields, bypass real providers or fabricate successful return.
limitations: Public reference sources are from other platforms and revisions; no identified drop-in enuma patch or unique hardware root cause.
Some connector fetch/search requests failed transiently; pinned public raw text was fetched directly and SHA256 recorded.
Timing inference remains indirect; GOP/ConOut/BDS/XNU not accepted.
